description: Search twelve free tube sites from one page: Pornhub, XVideos, SpankBang, Tube8, YouPorn, RedTube, Eporner, XNXX, xHamster, YouJizz, PornTrex and HQPorner. Filter by title, performer, channel/studio and tags, set a minimum and maximum length with a slider, hide trailers/shorts by title words, and include or hide channels. The Performer and Channel boxes double as Pornhub-style dropdowns with pictures, listing every performer and channel from the supported sites (refreshed daily), and performers can be starred into a Favorites list for one-click searches. Your library: favorite performers and channels with a "New from favorites" feed, Watch later, watched marking, saved searches with alerts, block lists, select-and-send in bulk, and the same video across sites merged into one card. Each account can optionally connect its own MeTube (with download progress), JDownloader, webhook, Discord or ntfy: videos get a Download button and saved searches can notify you. Admin page with accounts, sign-up switch and per-site health. Plug-ins add sites or destinations without rebuilding. Mobile friendly: phones and tablets get a touch layout automatically (slide-up filters, swipeable length chips, infinite scroll, full-screen player) and it can be installed to the home screen as an app. Optional accounts (needs Postgres): email/password, passkeys, security keys, authenticator-app two-step sign-in and Google/Facebook/Discord sign-in, with a per-user Security tab, and filters and favorites synced across devices; personal data is encrypted (AES-256-GCM). Fetches metadata only: videos play in each site's own embed player and nothing is downloaded or re-hosted.

env.name: DATABASE_URL
env.label: DATABASE_URL
env.description: Optional. postgresql://user:password@host:5432/db - enables accounts. Leave empty for search-only.

env.name: DATA_KEY
env.label: DATA_KEY
env.description: Required with accounts: 32 random bytes, base64url. Encrypts personal data - never change or lose it.

env.name: INDEX_KEY
env.label: INDEX_KEY
env.description: Required with accounts: a different 32-byte base64url key (lookups and code hashes).

env.name: PUBLIC_URL
env.label: PUBLIC_URL
env.description: Your public HTTPS address, e.g. https://search.example.com (needed for passkeys and Google/Facebook/Discord).

env.name: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.label: ADMIN_EMAILS
env.description: Optional. Comma-separated emails of accounts that get the Admin tab.

env.name: SEND_PRIVATE_HOSTS
env.label: SEND_PRIVATE_HOSTS
env.description: Optional. LAN addresses users may send to (MeTube, JDownloader, webhooks): host, host:port or CIDR, comma-separated, e.g. 192.168.1.10:8081. Empty = public addresses only.

env.name: ALERT_HOURS
env.label: ALERT_HOURS
env.description: How often saved-search alerts are checked (hours).

env.name: FEED_REFRESH_HOURS
env.label: FEED_REFRESH_HOURS
env.description: How often favorites are checked for new videos (hours).

env.name: PLUGINS_PATH
env.label: PLUGINS_PATH
env.description: Optional. Host folder with plug-ins (sources/*.py, targets/*.py). Empty = an empty named volume.

note: Adults only (18+). To expose it outside your LAN, either turn on accounts (DATABASE_URL, DATA_KEY, INDEX_KEY) with REQUIRE_LOGIN=true, or put it behind a reverse proxy with authentication (e.g. an Nginx Proxy Manager access list). For the home-screen install and passkeys, serve it over HTTPS. Generate DATA_KEY and INDEX_KEY with: python3 -c \"import secrets,base64;print(base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).decode())\" The performer/channel lists are built in the background on first start (about a minute) and kept in the naughty-site-aggregator-data volume. Send-to destinations and alerts need accounts; a MeTube/JDownloader/webhook on your LAN must be listed in SEND_PRIVATE_HOSTS (anyone who can register can make the server contact it, so list only what you need). Put your own email in ADMIN_EMAILS to get the Admin tab. Plug-ins run inside the server: only install code you trust (templates: plugins-example/ in the app repo). Pornhub and its sister sites (Tube8, YouPorn, RedTube) are blocked in some regions and will show as failed sources there.
